name: user_rating_count
description: Number of ratings given before the snapshot time

name: user_avg_rating
description: Mean rating given by the user (global mean for cold-start users)

name: user_rating_std
description: Standard deviation of the user's ratings

name: user_positive_ratio
description: Share of the user's ratings that are >= relevance threshold

name: user_active_days
description: Distinct calendar days with at least one rating

name: user_tenure_days
description: Days between first and last rating

name: user_days_since_last_interaction
description: Recency: days between the last rating and the snapshot time

name: user_preferred_genre
description: Genre with the most positive ratings (min. support applies)

name: user_genre_entropy
description: Shannon entropy of the user's genre distribution (taste breadth)

name: user_mainstreamness
description: Mean log-popularity of items the user rated

name: user_avg_release_year
description: Mean release year of items the user rated

name: age
description: User age (imputed by occupation median where missing/invalid)

name: gender
description: M / F / U (unknown)

name: occupation
description: Lower-cased occupation

name: is_cold_start
description: True if the user has no rating before the snapshot time

name: item_rating_count
description: Number of ratings received (popularity)

name: item_avg_rating
description: Raw mean rating (NaN if never rated)

name: item_bayesian_avg
description: Bayesian-average rating shrunk toward the global mean (m = 20)

name: item_rating_std
description: Standard deviation of the item's ratings (controversy)

name: item_popularity_rank
description: Rank by rating count (1 = most popular)

name: item_log_popularity
description: log(1 + rating count)

name: item_days_since_last_rating
description: Days between the item's last rating and the snapshot time

name: item_release_year
description: Release year (imputed from title when release date is missing)

name: item_age_years
description: Years between release date and snapshot time

name: item_primary_genre
description: First listed genre of the item

name: item_n_genres
description: Number of genres the item belongs to
